description: This file defines the Perl package Git::SVN::Ra, which wraps and extends SVN::Ra for use by git-svn. It includes methods for authentication, caching, repository operations, and compatibility handling across different SVN versions.

classes.name: Git::SVN::Ra
classes.description: A Perl class that extends SVN::Ra to add caching, compatibility, and convenience methods for git-svn integration.

methods.name: _auth_providers
methods.description: Defines and returns a list of SVN authentication provider objects.

methods.name: prepare_config_once
methods.description: Initializes SVN configuration and authentication parameters, with caching to run only once.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructs a new Git::SVN::Ra object for a given URL, with canonicalization and caching.

methods.name: check_path
methods.description: Checks if a path exists in the repository, with caching.

methods.name: get_dir
methods.description: Retrieves directory entries with caching and SVN version compatibility handling.

methods.name: get_log
methods.description: Retrieves commit logs with adjustments for SVN version limitations.

methods.name: trees_match
methods.description: Checks if two repository trees match, for older SVN versions.

methods.name: get_commit_editor
methods.description: Gets a commit editor, with SVN version compatibility.

methods.name: gs_do_update
methods.description: Performs an update operation on a git-svn working copy.

methods.name: gs_do_switch
methods.description: Performs a switch operation on a git-svn working copy, handling URL reparenting.

methods.name: longest_common_path
methods.description: Computes the longest common directory path among a set of git-svn objects and globs.

methods.name: gs_fetch_loop_common
methods.description: Fetches logs and updates for a range of revisions, handling errors and reinitializing SVN::Ra objects.

methods.name: get_dir_globbed
methods.description: Recursively retrieves directory entries matching a glob pattern.

methods.name: minimize_url
methods.description: Reduces a repository URL to its shortest form relative to the repository root.

methods.name: can_do_switch
methods.description: Checks if the SVN server supports the switch operation.

methods.name: skip_unknown_revs
methods.description: Handles specific SVN errors by ignoring certain error codes related to non-existent revisions.

methods.name: is_ref_ignored
methods.description: Determines if a reference path should be ignored based on regex patterns.

methods.name: match_globs
methods.description: Matches repository paths against glob patterns, retrieving directories as needed.
